contract:
Contract GenerateLoanLetterAndAgreementModule::listApprovalRequest(): Set(LoanRequest) {
	definition:
		approvedRequests: Set(LoanRequest) = LoanRequest.allInstances()
	precondition:
		approvedRequests.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		self.CurrentLoanRequests = LoanRequest.allInstances()->select(request: LoanRequest|request.Status = LoanRequestStatus::APPROVED) and
		result = LoanRequest.allInstances()->select(request: LoanRequest|request.Status = LoanRequestStatus::APPROVED)
}
